style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=12;fontColor=#334155;fontFamily=Helvetica;spacingTop=2;" value="1. Non-state events (audit trail only): arrived_at_center, assigned_to_trip, code_replaced (old code -> void), weight_corrected, outcome_corrected.<br/>2. Offline reconciliation: immutable sack_event_log folded by recorded_at + event_id; physical receiver (T3/T4/T7/T8) applies even if pickup/departure delayed.<br/>3. Transporter & center offline resilience: >=7d GNSS / custody outbox (2,016 fixes); center holds >=400 pre-issued reserve codes for unlabeled arrivals.<br/>4. Stores & recovery: DynamoDB (KMS records) + buyer_view projection (KMS public_view, origin/dates/status/drying vars only); RPO 15 min (S3 export) / RTO 4 h.<br/>5. Dashed lines = offline/receiver-authoritative skip path or rejection transition; bold border = terminal state." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="113" width="1842" x="49" y="758" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
1. Non-state events (audit trail only): arrived_at_center, assigned_to_trip, code_replaced (old code -> void), weight_corrected, outcome_corrected.
2. Offline reconciliation: immutable sack_event_log folded by recorded_at + event_id; physical receiver (T3/T4/T7/T8) applies even if pickup/departure delayed.
3. Transporter & center offline resilience: >=7d GNSS / custody outbox (2,016 fixes); center holds >=400 pre-issued reserve codes for unlabeled arrivals.
4. Stores & recovery: DynamoDB (KMS records) + buyer_view projection (KMS public_view, origin/dates/status/drying vars only); RPO 15 min (S3 export) / RTO 4 h.
5. Dashed lines = offline/receiver-authoritative skip path or rejection transition; bold border = terminal state.
